name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides, palms down.
Lift your legs so thighs point to the ceiling, knees bent.
Breathe out and curl your hips off the floor, bringing knees toward your chest.
Pause, then lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
Stop with thighs upright before the next rep.
cues: Curl the hips, do not swing the legs
Keep knees bent the whole time
Arms stay relaxed on the floor
Breathe out as the hips lift

common_mistakes.mistake: Swinging the legs to create momentum
common_mistakes.fix: Pause at the bottom and lift with the stomach only
Keep palms light on the floor

common_mistakes.mistake: Letting the feet drop to the floor
common_mistakes.fix: Stop when thighs are upright, then start the next rep
